title: Fluent Armenian Speakers Needed – Paid Voice Recording Project – Remote
job_description:
We are looking for native Armenian speakers to take part in a paid voice data project. The project involves collecting natural speech audio and matching transcripts for use in AI training and evaluation.

This is suitable for individuals, small groups, community organizers, recruiters, language specialists, or anyone who can help source native Armenian speakers and collect usable speech recordings.

What We Need

We are looking for natural spoken audio in Armenian . The audio can include single-speaker recordings or conversations between multiple speakers.

Project Volume: Each individual speaker can contribute up to 20 hours of audio per month.

Requirements

You should apply if you are:

A native Armenian speaker
Able to record yourself speaking naturally (no professional studio or complex equipment required)
Able to organize conversations with other native Armenian speakers
A community organizer, recruiter, translator, interpreter, linguist, student, or freelancer with access to Armenian speakers
Able to provide audio together with accurate transcripts

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
